Ambien Accidental Overdose
11pm-I took my nightly dose of 10mg of ambien for insomnia.
1145pm-I did what I usually do when I still cant get asleep, I took about 2 more 10mg pills.
1am-This is where things go fuzzy, in a sleep walk type of state in mind, I started eating them by 3s, and 5s. *in the morning I had 11 pills left when I had just filled the script the same day.*
1am-I had taken 190mg of ambien, 10mg under the ld50 for rats.
115am-At this time I had to get all this information the next day from my parents.  I was tripping harder than on any drug I've taken in the past. Acid, 2ci, 2ce, dxm, dmt, extacty..whatever it be this was 10x harder.
2-5am-Tripping nonstop with vivid hallucinations and heard voices talking to me.I saw covers moving, having to throw them off the couch or bed thinking some1 was in my house. Sitting in the bathroom floor for an hour so I wouldnt hear voices of any1 to turn around and no ones there.
I seemed to almost accidentally unintentionally kill myself. I even had minor seizures as I finally got to sleep around 6:30am.
The trip was insane and very graphic, but let me tell you, it was NOT worth it!
